name: Keenetic MCP
description: Keenetic router control for DipoleML, Codex, Cursor and any MCP agent. An MCP server over the router's own RCI API, plus ready-made plugins whose skills teach the agent how the hardware really behaves. Devices, Wi-Fi, VPN routing, isolated segments. Nothing installed on the router.
